text: This report provides an update of the primary activities and achievements of the Learning and Engagement unit for 2025. Learning and Engagement oversees a wide variety of different programs throughout the year that support key components of the Strategic Plan and further educational goals, including school programs and teacher resources, a roster of public programs for a variety of audiences/ages, virtual experiences, summer camps, and overnight experiences.
The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Received the report (February 2, 2026) from the Chief Operations Officer, Toronto Zoo for information.
